claims.claim: TomasuLLM reaches 1.31x on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1.27x on 18 SWE-Marathon sessions.
claims.episode_span: On 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks it reaches 1.31x, on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks it reaches 1.35x, and on 18 SWE-Marathon sessions it reaches 1.27x matched progress.
claims.source_title: TomasuLLM: Out-of-Order Speculative Execution for LLM Agents
claims.supporting_quote: Across three benchmarks spanning sub-second to minutes-long tool calls, TomasuLLM improves the reported benchmark means and scales with tool latency: 1.31x on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1.27x matched progress on 18 SWE-Marathon sessions.

claims.claim: GPT-5.6-Sol achieved cMAE within 10% of state-of-the-art RSF models for several cancer types and lower cMAE than RSF for prostate cancer in MSK-CHORD.
claims.episode_span: Frontier LLMs achieve cMAE within 10 percent of state-of-the-art random survival forests on several cancer types in the MSK-CHORD cohort and lower cMAE than RSF for prostate cancer.
claims.source_title: Large Language Models are Approximate Survival Estimators
claims.supporting_quote: For example, GPT-5.6-Sol achieved cMAE within 10% of state-of-the-art RSF models specifically trained for survival prediction for several cancer types and lower cMAE than RSF for prostate cancer in MSK-CHORD.
